changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, code, description) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, 'portal.payments.verify', 'Review payments awaiting finance for your own company, and approve (allocate the plot) or reject them.'); INSERT INTO role_permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, role_id, permission_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE r.code IN ('finance_officer', 'executive_director') AND p.code = 'portal.payments.verify';
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE permission_id IN (SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE code = 'portal.payments.verify'); DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code = 'portal.payments.verify';
